tab <- read.csv("../outputs/table01_country_year_characteristics.csv", check.names = FALSE)

\noindent\textbf{Table 1. Country-year characteristics by conflict exposure in the previous year}

\noindent Course panel of 186 countries, 2000-2019. All eligible country-years are retained before outcome-specific model exclusions.

```{r}
knitr::kable(tab, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "",
  col.names = c("Characteristic", "Summary", "Missing n", "Summary", "Missing n", "Summary", "Missing n"),
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"), escape = TRUE) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Overall (N = 3,720)" = 2,
                    "No prior conflict (N = 3,029)" = 2,
                    "Prior conflict (N = 691)" = 2)) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position", font_size = 9, position = "center") |>
  row_spec(c(5, 10, 14, 21), extra_latex_after = "\\addlinespace[2pt]") |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

\vspace{-2mm}
\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}
\small
Values are median [25th, 75th percentile] for continuous variables, except calendar years (range), and n (column \%) for categorical variables. Summaries use observed values;
categorical percentages use the non-missing group denominator. Missing n is shown for every variable, including zero. A dash means not applicable or
reported once in the Region header. OECD = Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development. Each binary row reports the yes category. Conflict exposure has no missing values.

N counts country-years, not independent countries. Each country has 20 years overall; exposure can change over time. There are 173 countries in the
no-prior-conflict stratum and 88 in the prior-conflict stratum; 75 contribute to both. Summaries are unweighted. No significance tests are used.

Prior conflict means at least one conflict with at least 25 deaths in that country during the preceding calendar year. Earthquake and drought refer
to the outcome year. All 372 maternal values for 2018-2019 are missing; there are 54 additional missing maternal values in 2000-2017. No imputation or
blanket complete-case exclusion was applied. Covariate scales are retained as supplied; the extract does not provide a complete unit codebook.

Source: validated Week 5 final data, derived from the course World Bank, conflict, disaster, and covariate extracts. This table describes the course
panel, not a reproduction of the published paper's final model sample. Prepared by Milly Wu.
\end{minipage}
